Area = 1/2 * |(0 * (1 - 3) + (-1) * (3 - 0) + 3 * (0 - 1))| = 1/2 * |(0 * (-2) + (-1) * 3 + 3 * (-1))| = 1/2 * |0 - 3 - 3| = 1/2 * |-6| = 3

Therefore, the area of the triangle is 3 square units.
